issues: Title: 'welk tweewieler' must be 'welke tweewieler' (de tweewieler).
Honda Lead, Yamaha Exciter and 'grotere modellen voor lange tochten' are attributed to Motogo/Vexere listings that do not contain them.
'sinds 2007 partij ... net als Vietnam' can be read as Vietnam joining in 2007; Viet Nam acceded 20 Aug 2014.
Low-emission-zone paragraph: the 'daarom ... het helpt wel' sentence is illogical because e-scooters are also banned in Zone 1 at those times.
MFA advice softened: source says 'Het is verstandig om een auto met chauffeur te huren', draft says 'eventueel'.
Summary recommends larger bikes to experienced riders without stating that this departs from the MFA under-50 cc advice.
Missed: Motogo lists a licence-free VinFast e-moped (max 50 km/h); Vexere shops limit use to the old Hanoi city area; MFA warns of landslides around Ha Giang.
Meta description too long (196 chars) and overclaims 'verkeersregels van 2026'.
'Controle voordat je wegrijdt' repeats the published /nl/checklist/ items; link instead.
About half of the body is sentence-parallel with PT-H01; rewrite natively.
notes: All cited sources opened live on 2026-10-15. Core claims verified: Dutch MFA advice (under 50 cc, sufficient experience, travel insurance covering vehicle accidents, Dutch licence valid only with an IDP; considering a car with driver advised), Netherlands acceded to the 1968 convention on 8 Nov 2007 and Viet Nam on 20 Aug 2014, Law 36/2024 Art. 57 A1 up to 125 cm3 or 11 kW, A above, and the Ring Road 1 low-emission-zone dates and phase-1 weekend evening ban. Factual accuracy fails on attribution of model names to the cited listings; fluency fails on a title gender error and an illogical sentence. Strict fact guard found no prices, phones, addresses, hours or reviews. Reviewer: a separate Claude subagent instance with fresh context and web access; same model family as the writer session, not a human.
